Rtarget=np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])

def step(a):
 a=np.asarray(a,dtype=np.float64);a=np.clip(a,s.action_space.low,s.action_space.high)
 ob,success,done=s.step(a);acts.append(a.copy())
 if success:print('SUCCESS',s.t);s.save_trajectory(acts,'/app/output/trajectory.npz');sys.exit()

def go(pos,n=50,grip=0,R=Rtarget,base=None,orient=True):

  cur=d.site_xpos[site].copy();rot=d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3).copy()
  ep=(pos-cur)
  er=Rotation.from_matrix(R@rot.T).as_rotvec()

  e=np.r_[ep,.3*er] if orient else ep
